items.title: Duffy Probing Possible L3Harris ‘Incompetence’ in FAA Meltdown
items.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Saturday that officials are looking into whether aerospace and defense contractor L3Harris Technologies Inc. was at fault for an aviation traffic control system shutdown that grounded flights nationwide for more than four hours.

items.title: Duffy Says an L3Harris Crew Was Working on the FAA Network When Flights Stopped. Its Stock Fell 4% After Hours
items.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said an L3Harris crew was switching FAA lines from copper wire to fiber when a router flooded the air traffic control network. L3Harris fell 4.2% after hours, and airlines owe stranded travelers nothing.
